name: OIDC provider unreachable: the expired token is renewed before the request with 3 attempts shared by the screen, then the popup
description: The token endpoint of the OIDC provider stops answering (the browser cannot reach it). The background renewal fails, the token expires, the next screen change makes the application renew the token before the request: 3 attempts 1 second apart, one renewal for every widget of the screen (not one per widget), then the popup "Session has expired". When the provider is back, "Yes" leads to the login page and the application works. The token lifetime is shortened for the test and put back afterwards.
descriptionHtml:
The token endpoint of the OIDC provider stops answering (the browser cannot reach it). The background renewal fails, the token expires, the next screen change makes the application renew the token before the request: 3 attempts 1 second apart, one renewal for every widget of the screen (not one per widget), then the popup "Session has expired". When the provider is back, "Yes" leads to the login page and the application works. The token lifetime is shortened for the test and put back afterwards.

Manual run: 📋 Copy application.Samples.Feature.authError.AuthErrorPopupTest#providerUnreachable_threeSharedAttemptsThenPopup into GitHub Actions → Run Workflow → include PATH
